text:
emily_chen: Heads-up — seeing a surge of unowned inbound leads in HubSpot since the midnight deploy :grimacing:
ops_bot: ALERT: hs-unclaimed queue > 420 contacts (rolling 1h) — source=website, utm=paid_search
raj_patel: Any idea if the round-robin mapping changed in the workflow?
emily_chen: Looks like the new enrichment step (hs-enrich-v2) added a delay and the HS workflow's fallback owner rule got accidentally removed during the refactor. enrichment TTL is 2m currently so claims are timing out.
dina_k: Ugh. So leads create -> enrich -> assign RR -> but fallback_after not set? that explains the spike.
leon_s: Can we do a quick hotfix: set fallback window to 60s and enable periodic claim-retry heartbeat while we patch the long-term flow?
emily_chen: I'm able to patch the HS workflow. Proposed quick change (HubSpot workflow YAML snippet):
```yaml
workflow:
  trigger: contact_create
  steps:
    - enrich: hs-enrich-v2
    - assign: round_robin_sales_team
    - fallback_after_seconds: 60  # was removed by mistake
    - enable_claim_retry: true
```
raj_patel: Also need to make sure SF owner mapping still respects `hs_owner_id` on sync. Last SF connector upgrade changed the mapping key. I'll add a guard to skip null owner writes.
dina_k: Short-term runbook for Sales: notify @sales via channel and add a manual claim queue view. We should throttle marketing paid channels until counts drop.
leon_s: I'll open a canary release for the workflow change and monitor claim success rate + latency. Add an alert: claim-fail-rate > 5% -> page eng oncall.
emily_chen: Quick claim-retry snippet for the worker if anyone needs it:
```js
// naive retry loop for claim API
async function claimWithRetry(id, retries=5){
  try{ await hsApi.claimContact(id); return true }
  catch(e){ if(retries<=0) throw e; await sleep(5000); return claimWithRetry(id, retries-1) }
}
```
maria_s: If we change fallback to 60s, please update lead routing doc and let SDRs know via the handoff channel. I can draft the note.
emily_chen: Action items:
- emily_chen -> patch HS workflow fallback_after_seconds=60 + enable_claim_retry (hotfix) (ETA 20m)
- raj_patel -> add SF guard to ignore null owner writes and backfill owner for stuck contacts (ETA 2h)
- leon_s -> canary release + add alert for claim-fail-rate (ETA 30m)
- maria_s -> send SDR notification + temp pause paid campaign if counts don't drop in 1h
ops_bot: DEPLOYMENT: workflow/hubspot patched by emily_chen at 2422223389 (deploy id: wf-2431) :white_check_mark:
emily_chen: Patch deployed and canary on. initial metrics look better — unowned queue down to 87. Will monitor and follow up in 30m.
raj_patel: I'll run a quick backfill script for the 420 stuck contacts after we confirm stability.
emily_chen: Thanks all — filing a short postmortem/ops note once we have final numbers. Link to runbook: https://redwood-internal/ops/runbooks/lead-routing-fallback (internal)
